text: The Patriots are headed into their Week 5 matchup against the Raiders significantly depleted on the defensive back side, ruling out both starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck), which prompted the team to sign CB Kindle Vildor from the practice squad to bolster the secondary—though there's some brighter news on the offensive side, with RB Rhamondre Stevenson returning to practice after missing time. The roster shuffling ahead of Sunday's game included placing veteran WR Mack Hollins and FB Reggie Gilliam on injured reserve while activating special-teams ace Brenden Schooler to the 53-man roster, leaving the Patriots facing a Raiders offense led by QB Kirk Cousins, who's had one of the NFL's most surprising starts to the season. On a lighter note, the team will honor Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri during halftime with a ceremony celebrating his induction, and the Patriots will be wearing throwback uniforms as part of Week 5's league-wide uniform showcase.
